en.title: Range Count of Strings Starting and Ending with Vowels
en.description:
Each query gives a 1-based closed interval l-r; count the strings in it whose first and last characters are both lowercase vowels aeiou. A single-character vowel qualifies.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n q, followed by n lines of non-empty lowercase strings, then q lines of l-r. The source has no numeric bounds; on this site n,q≤100000, total characters ≤10^6, 1≤l≤r≤n.
en.output: Output q integers in query order.
hints: Mark each string 0/1, build prefix sums, and answer each query with a difference.
